name: Geeqie 3.4
body:
- Performance: configurable multi-image preloading that follows navigation direction, bounded thumbnail loading and memory use, faster selection navigation, smoother Exif scrolling, and asynchronous display-profile loading.
- Pan View: background directory scanning, incremental layout and spatial indexing, progress reporting, cancellation, and support for Geeqie’s private thumbnail cache.
- Rendering and zoom: faster magnification through reusable textures; corrected high-DPI, 100% zoom, and fullscreen behavior; fixes for blank images, stale previews, tiling artifacts, and color correction.
- File operations: directory drag-and-drop copying and moving, folder merging, “Duplicate” conflict handling, and fixes for cancellation, symlink targets, and maximum-length filenames.
- Floating tools and shortcuts: an option to keep Info and Sort Manager with floating tools; corrected menu placement and docking; file drops onto folder and collection shortcuts.
- Sort Manager and collections: folder-specific destination lists, numbered destination shortcuts, external collections in destination menus, a draggable divider, and fixes for sidebar width growth.
- Metadata: configurable XMP color labels with OSD and list-view indicators, corrected grouped-sidecar associations, image/XMP source selection in the Exif window, keyword-tree autosaving, and restored batch metadata application.
- Search and duplicates: separate Criteria and Results tabs, perceptual-hash matching, a same-folder exclusion filter, smallest/largest-file selection, JSON export and script integration, and improved synchronization after deletion.
- Slideshow: configurable transitions, improved high-DPI rendering, and rescanning of recursive folders or saved collections between cycles.
- Export and printing: cropped-copy export with an adjustable selection, JPEG/PNG conversion, restored proof-sheet printing, and Print Image in context menus.
- Keyboard and customization: configurable panning and other formerly hard-coded shortcuts, an action to focus the image pane, improved icon-view selection and focus, configurable date/time formatting, and interface color-scheme preferences.
- GPS and format support: restored map interactions and direction lines; fixes for animated WebP, AVIF crashes, JPEG XL profiles and alpha, large JPEGs, full-resolution ARW viewing, SVGZ loading, and metadata-preserving rotation.
- Packaging and maintenance: AppImage workflow and GTK 4.18 compatibility fixes, Snap Bash completion, AppImage/Flatpak completion documentation, clearer PDF-manual dependency diagnostics, highlighted documentation previews, and expanded automated tests.
- Multiple code improvements

name: Geeqie 3.3
body:
- Collections: Open Collection combines the default collection directory with collection history, showing filenames and full paths. Unavailable collections are retained but disabled. Missing images remain in collections, and collections stored elsewhere are updated when images move or are renamed.
- Open Recent: Replaced with a GTK4 dialog using GTK’s shared recent-files database, with “Geeqie image files” and “All files” filters. Collection history now has its own setting and `[collection_history]` section.
- Keyboard operation: Improved Return activation, search submission and results navigation, folder-pane focus, address-bar history, and Escape handling across dialogs and editable fields.
- File operations: Added inline folder creation. Fixed a renaming crash, empty-folder trash handling, destination selection, and unnecessary permission warnings for plugins.
- Rendering: Cached tile textures improve zooming and panning. The bird’s-eye overview is cached, and an overlay cleanup crash was fixed. Stereo switching and cursor behavior were corrected.
- Metadata and interface: Added smartphone-video GPS support through optional libavformat integration. Fixed GPS-related file-list updates, EXIF entry creation, histogram sizing, and initial scrolling. Bundled icons provide fallbacks when themes lack them.
- Startup and plugins: Plugin discovery runs in a worker thread. Configuration migration prompts and missing-layout notifications were corrected.
- Build and releases: Fixed NetBSD authors generation, preserved AppImage payloads during release preparation, added Snap CI builds, and automated source-release preparation from reviewed `NEWS`.
- Maintenance: Expanded regression tests, updated translations and documentation, removed the obsolete desktop-template helper, and simplified sidebar and collection internals.

name: Geeqie 3.2
body:
- Collections integrated into the main window. .gqv files appear as virtual folders, with their
    contents displayed in the files pane. Collection management now includes editing, appending,
    saving, reordering, sorting, randomizing, and navigating to an image’s original folder.
    Standalone collection windows and collection previews were removed. Unsaved changes are protected
    by Save/Discard/Cancel prompts.

  - Collection information and paths improved. Added editing and display of per-image collection info
    text, including in the overlay display. Added forced relative-path saving. Collection list rows
    now show filenames with full-path tooltips and a collection-only “Sort by path” option. Opening
    collections with Enter or double-click was fixed.

  - Extensive GTK4 modernization. Migrated the icon view to GtkGridView, and search results, file
    filters, shortcut configuration, plugin lists, file-operation lists, and advanced EXIF displays
    to GtkColumnView. Converted folder lists and layout configuration to newer widgets. Replaced
    numerous deprecated drawing, dialog, positioning, and widget APIs and removed compatibility
    wrappers. The files list and directory tree still retain legacy APIs.

  - Keyboard shortcuts and menus revised. Made shortcuts consistently configurable, revised defaults
    toward GNOME conventions, added per-window keyboard maps, improved conflict reporting, and fixed
    plugin shortcut overrides and duplicate detection. Fixed menu keyboard navigation, F10
    activation, focus restoration, folder-tree toggling, and inverted boolean actions. Configured
    shortcuts now appear in tooltips and plugin context menus.

  - Files-pane interaction improved. Added an adjustable, remembered filename-column width and
    display of the date used for sorting. Fixed selection in folder lists and search results, main-
    menu selection actions, right-click preservation of multiple selections, and selection when
    starting a drag. Improved drag-and-drop between Geeqie windows and fixed Wayland drops into
    Signal.

  - Image display and rendering corrected. Fixed undersized thumbnails, intermittent AVIF thumbnail
    failures, search and duplicate-window thumbnails, excessive mouse-wheel image skipping, and fuzzy
    overlay text at 200% scaling. Added an optional navigator overlay. Improved rendering queues,
    coalesced redraw requests, restored configurable tile caching, and prevented oversized-image
    scaling crashes.
    
  - Metadata and color handling improved. Fixed MP4 EXIF reading, embedded ICC-profile handling,
    color-management menus, and invisible GPS markers. Enabled color management in full AppImages.
    Added a metadata-key entry to the sidebar’s Add menu and a rating “greater than or equal to”
    filter. Fixed deleting keywords from multiple files and a metadata-buffer crash.

  - File operations and dialogs refined. Revised Geeqie’s trash system, clarified copy/cut behavior,
    corrected the GNOME clipboard MIME type, and fixed filename completion in address and copy
    dialogs. Added a “Current folder” button to file choosers and fixed Latin-1 filename handling. An
    intermediate copy/move dialog change was reverted.

  - Layout and general UI fixes. Repaired horizontal and vertical splits, sidebar expanders,
    transparent window borders, duplicated toolbar contents, automatic navigation to the next folder,
    and fullscreen plugin availability. Improved theme-based image borders, pan-view scrolling and
    filtering, and spelling-checker behavior.

  - Shutdown and memory fixes. Corrected sidebar removal, directory-view lifetime during destruction,
    and rating-popover cleanup to eliminate normal-quit warnings. Fixed a keyword-sidebar memory leak
    and several pointer/compiler warnings. Thumbnail-size tracking was simplified to avoid deprecated
    widget calls.

  - Build, packaging, and testing updated. Added deprecation-warning build options and test coverage,
    resolved Meson option naming inconsistencies, fixed debug builds, and excluded tests from source
    correctness checks. Added AppImage update information, fixed Snap SVG support, and expanded
    isolated-display tooling for Wayland/Weston.

  - Documentation, translations, and internal cleanup. Updated German and other translation catalogs,
    corrected translation format validation, and revised translation maintenance. Added contributor
    guidance and EditorConfig settings. Refactored configuration writing, metadata storage, event
    handling, sidebar implementations, and numerous helpers to reduce duplication and unused code.

  - Revised Bash completions
